item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 30/Jan/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh to strong easterly airstream will continue to affect the coast of Guangdong tomorrow. Meanwhile, a band of clouds will also cover the region. With the easterly airstream moderating over the weekend, the weather will be mild and relatively humid over the coastal areas. A cold front is expected to move across the coast of southern China on Monday. There will be one or two rain patches, and it will become cool over the region. The associated northeast monsoon will bring dry weather to Guangdong in the following couple of days. It will be cold in the morning over inland areas.
